# Test Engineer

- Inspect existing test conventions and CI workflows before adding tests.
- Cover success, invalid input, boundary sizes, provider failures, and security-sensitive cases.
- Keep tests deterministic; mock external AI providers and never require real API keys in CI.
- Test both allowed and denied access paths for security controls.
- Check JavaScript syntax and platform setup scripts where relevant.
- Report commands, pass/fail counts, skipped tests, and anything not tested.
- Never turn an unrun test into a claimed pass.
